---
title: "Sri Lanka Country String Diagnostic"
output: html_document
---

```{r check}
library(sparklyr)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)

sc <- spark_connect(method = "databricks")

global_tbl <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("era5-daily-data", "silver_dev",
  "aer_era5_silver_approximate_1950_to_present_dev_interpolation_res5"))

# Get ALL columns to understand schema
schema_sample <- global_tbl %>%
  filter(country %like% "%Lanka%") %>%
  head(3) %>%
  collect()

# What does time column look like?
time_sample <- global_tbl %>%
  filter(country %like% "%Lanka%") %>%
  select(time) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  collect()

# Distinct year values (via mutate+distinct)
yr_vals <- global_tbl %>%
  filter(country %like% "%Lanka%") %>%
  mutate(yr = year(time)) %>%
  select(yr) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(yr) %>%
  collect()

# Row count with year filter applied same way as app
lk_app_rows <- global_tbl %>%
  filter(country == "Sri Lanka") %>%
  mutate(yr = year(time), mo = month(time)) %>%
  filter(yr >= 1973, yr <= 2023) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_pixels = n_distinct(longitude, latitude),
            min_yr = min(yr), max_yr = max(yr)) %>%
  collect()

results <- list(
  schema_sample  = schema_sample,
  time_sample    = time_sample,
  yr_vals        = yr_vals,
  lk_app_rows    = lk_app_rows
)
saveRDS(results, "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/diag_sri_lanka.rds")

cat("Schema sample:\n"); print(schema_sample)
cat("\nTime sample:\n"); print(time_sample)
cat("\nDistinct years:\n"); print(yr_vals)
cat("\nApp filter row count:\n"); print(lk_app_rows)

spark_disconnect(sc)
```
